slices.red: caller-authored decision and risk facts are rejected
slices.green: Acceptance derives a current decision from repository-bound references
slices.regression: run Acceptance requirement and schema tests

slices.red: schema revision and trigger policy behavior are inconsistent
slices.green: closed policy, blocked status, and current policy hash are enforced

slices.red: blocked or provenance-stale decisions reach route preparation
slices.green: route preparation rejects blocked/stale decisions before Bootstrap

slices.red: terminal evidence and lifecycle projection disagree, or projection tests assume a clean real worktree instead of observing a controlled candidate effect
slices.green: a current terminal predicate may publish implementation-complete without acceptance authority; stale knowledge context instead remains explicitly blocked, and projection tests use an isolated Git baseline
slices.regression: run plan-local implementation validator and lifecycle tests
